title: Interview: John Lennon for Los Angeles Times | 1974
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to the Los Angeles Times on 20 September 1974.

It focused on Lennon’s forthcoming album Walls And Bridges. The interviewer was Robert Hilburn, and the exchange took place at Lennon’s room at the Beverly Wilshire Hotel in Los Angeles.
